not_covered_here: The operator override of the reference file is not bound into the signed launch yet; the Gateway uses the packaged file only.
Registry snapshots carry hash, models, tiers, roles and list prices, not routes (the Task 1 contract omits them).
Startup or probe receipts without a session are not shown as unallocated overhead yet (Task 3 attribution).
Delivery backlog is the host's to report (Task 4); the Gateway reports no delivery_pending of its own.
The host's bounded response read is Task 4; Task 2's real-HTTP cases use the existing production urllib transport.
